- Model consistently underestimates true prices, especially in the early part of the forecast horizon (first 5–10 days).
- Overestimates after sharp price spikes (e.g., 68+), often overshooting by 2–5 points and failing to correct.
- Shows persistent lag in capturing true price momentum — forecasts lag behind actual price movements by 2–4 days.
- Mean reversion bias: model assumes prices will return to historical averages too quickly, underestimating volatility in high-price regimes.
- Overly conservative in low-price zones — fails to anticipate rebounds from dips, especially after 60–62.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts are overly sensitive to recent low prices, underreacting to high-price trends.
